scope: Recovered updater worker paths. The MFC WM_COMMAND edges for Update (control 1) and Feedback (control 1005) are statically recovered; the Review & Print UI edge remains UNKNOWN.

evidence.claim: Native MFC PE32 application startup exists.

states.trigger: WM_COMMAND notification code 0 for dialog control 1 (Update)
states.expected_response: worker callback 0x00410310 is submitted to the MFC thread-launcher candidate

evidence.claim: The exact WM_COMMAND/control-1 record maps to a handler that pushes callback 0x00410310 and calls the common worker launcher.

states.usb_operation: orchestrates standard device discovery and dangerous artifact stages
states.expected_response: worker reaches the product-ID branch before selecting an artifact
states.failure_behavior: worker/UI error path; exact visible text UNKNOWN

evidence.claim: The Update callback contains the device-ID branch and calls the dangerous worker at +0x00410C25, +0x00410F10, and +0x00411002.

states.condition: a matching SetupAPI interface is present
states.expected_response: valid WinUSB handle and dynamically enumerated pipe map
states.failure_behavior: UI error / worker failure path; exact message mapping UNKNOWN

evidence.claim: SetupAPI enumeration, CreateFileA, and WinUsb_Initialize calls are present.
The connected VOD700 is accessible through Microsoft WinUSB.
The function reads the standard descriptor and its caller compares idProduct to 0x5265.

states.failure_behavior: non-0x5265 branch includes command 0x07 and DM300 paths

evidence.claim: The VOD700 PID branch selects the DM100 McuCode path.

states.usb_operation: 0x01 interrupt OUT static frame 55AA07...06; expected 0x81 response command 0x87
states.expected_response: response payload at offset 3 is compared with ASCII 1.26
states.failure_behavior: non-match takes an Erase.bin route; this is a dangerous alternate-device path

evidence.claim: The alternate branch builds 0x07, validates 0x87, and compares response payload bytes with 1.26.

states.condition: match selects DM300/McuCode.bin; non-match tries DM300/Erase.bin then Erase.bin
states.usb_operation: same dangerous worker receives stage command 0x03 followed by final interrupt command 0x02; wire details are not captured for this branch

evidence.claim: The alternate branch opens its artifact path and invokes the dangerous worker; it is outside the VOD700 PID path.

states.trigger: WM_COMMAND notification code 0 for dialog control 1005 (Feedback)
states.expected_response: worker callback 0x0040DB30 is submitted to the MFC thread-launcher candidate

evidence.claim: The exact WM_COMMAND/control-1005 record maps to a handler that pushes the feedback worker callback 0x0040DB30.

states.expected_response: 16-byte 0x8B with little-endian value 0x02000000 in captured/validated case
states.failure_behavior: static fallback path attempts a bounded 0x06 probe; exact fallback live behavior not captured

evidence.claim: Official updater 0x0B/0x8B exchange.
One policy-gated physical exchange matched the capture.
The value is decoded and used to calculate tail-region addresses.

states.condition: capacity query returns and each 0x86 acknowledgement succeeds
states.usb_operation: 32 iterations of 0x06 address request on 0x01 -> 0x86 on 0x81 -> 0x1008 bulk IN read on 0x82
states.expected_response: AA55AA55 + 4096 data + big-endian SUM32; USBPcap currently splits it as 4096 then 8 bytes
states.failure_behavior: worker failure UI path; a cancelled IRP is not a device reply

evidence.claim: Two complete iterations at 0x01FB0000 and 0x01FB1000 were captured; third request completion was USBD_STATUS_CANCELED.
Worker computes capacity-0x50000, loops 32 times in 0x1000 steps, reads 0x1008 bytes, and writes Feedback.bin on the host.

states.condition: capacity query returns and 0x06/0x86 transactions succeed
states.usb_operation: 30 iterations from capacity-0x30000 using the same 0x06 and bulk-IN shape
states.expected_response: worker accepts pages whose bulk data begins with ASCII AUTOPHIX
states.failure_behavior: worker reports failure if no accepted pages; exact UI mapping UNKNOWN

evidence.claim: Worker allocates 0x1E000, loops 30 4 KiB reads, checks AUTOPHIX at post-transport data offset 0, and renders a host Review & Print.txt file.

states.trigger: dangerous update worker after DM100 source is loaded
states.usb_operation: 0x03 interrupt frame with a big-endian page count, then 0x83 response
states.expected_response: 0x83 acknowledgement; capture shows 71 pages for DM100 McuCode.bin
states.failure_behavior: update worker returns failure and UI path re-enables controls

evidence.claim: Exact 0x03/0x83 exchange captured.
Worker calculates ceiling(source_size / 0x1000) and places it big-endian in the 0x03 frame.

states.trigger: each full source page in dangerous update worker
states.usb_operation: 0x01 interrupt frame carrying 0x1000 big-endian, then 0x81 response
states.failure_behavior: worker returns failure before bulk transfer

evidence.claim: Exact 0x01/0x81 exchange captured.
Worker sends this handshake before pipe-selector-3 (endpoint 0x02) bulk OUT.

states.usb_operation: 0x02 bulk OUT: 55AA55AA + raw 4 KiB source page + big-endian SUM32
states.expected_response: subsequent interrupt IN was pending when containment stopped the capture; normal completion response UNKNOWN
states.failure_behavior: dangerous worker returns failure on transfer/ack failure

evidence.claim: One valid official-updater bulk OUT was captured; the following IN IRP was cancelled by capture containment before a response.
Worker copies source bytes unchanged into the bulk frame and appends big-endian SUM32.

states.condition: Update.exe does not take its command-0x03 failure branch
states.usb_operation: host formats and opens bin/ExtFlashDat.bin, then invokes dangerous worker with 0x04 and big-endian page count 0x1D36; static loop then uses 0x01/page and pipe-selector-3 bulk OUT
states.expected_response: 0x84 interrupt acknowledgement is statically expected; no command-0x04 USB records are retained
states.failure_behavior: worker/UI error branch after a failed command-0x04 call

evidence.claim: The VOD700 Update worker formats ExtFlashDat.bin and calls the same dangerous worker with stage command 0x04 after the initial command-0x03 source stage succeeds.

states.condition: Update.exe does not take its command-0x04 failure branch
states.usb_operation: dangerous worker constructs interrupt command 0x02 with zero page-count argument; exact static request 55AA0200000000000000000000000001
states.expected_response: 0x82 interrupt acknowledgement is statically expected; no USB record is retained
states.failure_behavior: worker/UI error branch after a failed command-0x02 call

evidence.claim: The Update worker calls the dangerous worker with command 0x02 after the command-0x04 stage succeeds; the device effect is not recovered.

transitions.condition: static-only branch; no VOD700 or alternate-device capture exists
feedback worker starts and its interrupt transaction succeeds
the selected host artifact opens and the command-0x03 worker is called
normal bulk acknowledgement/worker completion was not captured, but the static success path is recovered
static branch only; no command-0x04 capture exists

blocked_actions: No state after update_prepare may be replayed, transmitted, or tested live by this project.
The 0x06 tail-storage states remain parser/planning only until read-only semantics are independently established and a future explicit approval is given.
No MFC UI automation, updater patching, or firmware file modification was used to create this model.
